ticket.title: Extract gaugeblock-security for suite-wide redaction
ticket.description: Redaction and secret detection are domain-neutral yet live in miter-engine, so joiner and rabbet link redb, sqlparser, hcl, dockerfile-parser, serde_yaml, globset, rayon and miter-storage only to scrub telemetry text. Extract gaugeblock-security into the common repo (packages are gaugeblock-<thing>, not common-<thing>) holding shannon_entropy, is_high_entropy_secret, is_sensitive_identifier, is_secret_literal and scrub_source_text - all std-only - and fold polyglot::redact::redacted_value in so redaction has one home. Keep engine's pub mod security as a re-export shim, then repoint joiner and rabbet. Release note: the name needs a 0.1.0-alpha.1 reservation before 0.1.0-beta.1 can publish.

verification_receipt.summary: Delivered: common/crates/gaugeblock-security holds the entropy/identifier/secret-literal/scrub primitives with a re-export shim left in miter; joiner-core and rabbet-core now take redaction from the foundation crate (commits d5d451a, ef6661f, c54674c).
